text:
For an iPhone 17, I'd pick between two slim power banks, depending on how much capacity you want. iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless charging, but only the 10K models below reach that speed.

**Best slim overall (5,000 mAh): Anker Nano Power Bank, $54.99**
- It's 0.34 in thick and weighs 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than the competition.
- [Buy at Anker](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Macworld says 5K packs usually top a phone up about 60-75%, which is enough to get you to an outlet. ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html))

**Best slim with more capacity (10,000 mAh): INIU SnapGo Air, about $43-45**
- It's 0.5 in thick and weighs 195 g, with 25W Qi2.2 wireless and 45W wired charging.
- It includes a 60W lanyard-style USB-C cable.
- Android Central picked it for value. Macworld lists it as tied for the slimmest 10K pack.
- Prices at the time of the review: $42.99 on Amazon, $44.99 at INIU. See the [Android Central review](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge) for the buy links. I didn't get a direct product URL.

**Other options**
- **Thinnest possible: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K).** At 0.27 in and 104 g, Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the group. However, wireless charging tops out at 7.5W, and it's priced $52.99-$69.99. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))
- **Fast 25W 10K from Baseus: PicoGo AM52.** It lists at $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52. That code was tested by a coupon site that earns an affiliate commission. The page doesn't give a thickness, so it may not be as slim as the others. ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w))
- **Rugged: TORRAS MiniMag Pro (10K).** It has an IP54 water and dust rating and 15W wireless. It's 0.57 in thick and costs $69.99. ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge))

**Things to keep in mind**
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker says cases over 2.5 mm may interfere.
- Wireless charging is less efficient than a cable. If you want maximum charge per trip, pick a 10K model.
